directory.title: Directory
directory.intro: Connect a principal directory so users and groups can be picked throughout the app. v1 supports Microsoft Entra ID (via a UC HTTP Connection), a Postgres / Lakebase table, or a local CSV file for tests and demos.

entra.setupBody: Create a Unity Catalog HTTP connection against Microsoft Graph with client_credentials. The app's enterprise app must hold at least User.Read.All and GroupMember.Read.All (or Group.Read.All) application scopes.

lakebase.tableHelp: Fully-qualified name of a Postgres table on the app's primary Lakebase database. Identifier segments must contain only letters, digits, and underscores.
lakebase.schemaBody: Populate this table from your IdP sync pipeline. Indexes on lower-cased columns are optional but recommended for snappy prefix search.

file.pathHelp: Absolute path to a CSV file readable by the app process. Re-read automatically when the file's mtime advances; no restart needed.
file.formatBody: Required columns: type, id, display_name. The sub_label column is optional. type must be user or group.
